facts.claim: Climate Card cannot be used to board at ICN T1/T2; airport alighting is permitted.
New machines in Seoul Metro stations sell/load Climate Cards; short-term passes are 1/2/3/5/7 days and start on loading day.
Official purchase/top-up guidance explicitly includes Line 1 Seoul Station in the Cheongnyangni–Seoul Station range.
Seoul Metro lines 1–8 have card machines; Seoul Station subway side uses lines 1 and 4. No exact exit, opening hours, price, stock or ICN sales availability is asserted.
